property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list and any amount, when caddress is a contract exposing a valid transferFrom(address,address,uint256), the reference C's transfer must succeed and route exactly one well-formed transferFrom call per recipient to that contract; the mutant builds a wrong selector so every such call reverts and transfer must revert or fail to deliver.
change_summary: Change the transferFrom selector string casing to an invalid selector, causing all calls to revert when caddress is a real token contract.
